<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="37" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">GraphSAGE sampled mean  |  Module overview</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">module only / reviewed fixed source / independent operands  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="289.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f8d4e1" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="312.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="312.0" dy="0">Inputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="474.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c8ebfb" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="497.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="497.0" dy="0">Propagation</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="659.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="682.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="682.0" dy="0">Parameters</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="844.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#fff6bd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="867.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="867.0" dy="0">Add / norm</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1029.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1052.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1052.0" dy="0">Tensor ops</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1214.0" y="694" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9f1cd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1237.0" y="707" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1237.0" dy="0">Gates</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="659.0" y="724" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f3f5f7" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="682.0" y="737" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="682.0" dy="0">Topology</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="844.0" y="724" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="867.0" y="737" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="867.0" dy="0">Output</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="765" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="839" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="869" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="894" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
